description:
Probe each distinct external URL once per link-check run, through one HTTP agent that has a request timeout, with a fixed bound on concurrent requests.

## Background

- `validate_external_url` (`crates/jit/src/commands/document.rs:1060-1083`) builds a new `ureq::Agent::new_with_defaults()` for every external asset and sends a `HEAD` request; `check_document_links` (`:1098` onwards) calls it inside its per-document, per-asset loop (`:1249-1280`), serially and once per occurrence. ureq 3.2's default configuration has no timeout, so an unresponsive host stalls the run.
- `validate_external_url` never returns `Err`, so the `url_validation_failed` warning branch (`:1264-1277`) is unreachable; every failure is reported as an `unreachable_url` error.
- `ureq` 3.2 offers `Agent::config_builder().timeout_global(...)` and `Agent::new_with_config`, and an `Agent` is `Clone + Send + Sync`; `std::thread::scope` needs no new dependency.
- `crates/jit/Cargo.toml:60-71` says `Agent::new_with_defaults()` is the only call site; the module doc of `crates/jit/tests/cli_query_graph/remote_document_tls_tests.rs:6-12` says its agent is configured exactly like that call site. `tests/cli_query_graph/check_links_tests.rs:11-31` has an offline loopback HTTP server.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A run collects the distinct external URLs of every checked document, probes each once through one agent with a request timeout, from a fixed number of `std::thread::scope` workers, and reports each occurrence from that probe's outcome.
- [hard] REQ-02: A CLI test with a request-counting loopback server and two documents citing one URL shows one request; it fails on today's code, which sends two.
- [hard] REQ-03: A unit test shows that a probe of a listener that accepts and never answers completes within the configured timeout and reports the URL unreachable.
- [hard] REQ-04: The unreachable `url_validation_failed` branch is gone, and the `Cargo.toml` comment and the TLS test module doc describe the agent as configured now.

## Notes

- Behaviour change: an unresponsive host is reported unreachable after the timeout instead of stalling the run. Status classification is otherwise unchanged.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Link checking probes each distinct URL once through one timed agent
